findings.title: Redirecting URL listed in sitemap
findings.description: /paidadvertising-1 is in pages-sitemap.xml but 301s to /seo-freelancer-in-bangalore. Leftover Wix auto-slug.
findings.recommendation: Remove from sitemap; sitemaps should list only canonical 200 URLs.

findings.title: No lastmod values in sitemap
findings.description: No recrawl priority signal given to crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Emit lastmod per URL.

findings.title: Four security headers absent
findings.description: CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy missing. HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options present.
findings.recommendation: Hardening only, not ranking factors, and largely Wix-controlled. No action required.

findings.title: Wix returns 429 to non-browser User-Agents
findings.description: A crawler identifying as SEO-audit/1.0 got 429 on all 86 URLs; a Chrome UA got 200. Wix also throttles sustained crawling regardless of UA.
findings.recommendation: For your own audits set a browser UA and throttle to ~0.2 req/s.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Median 1,347 words across 86 pages
Google Partner certification stated WITH a verifiable link
12 named client logos
Real named practitioner with 7 sameAs profiles including two .edu.in author pages
Homepage readability: 18.0 words per sentence

findings.title: No author bylines or dates on 68 blog posts
findings.description: Zero matches for author/byline/updated text across all posts. All carry BlogPosting schema but show no visible attribution. Most incongruent finding on a site named EEAT Minds.
findings.recommendation: Visible byline linked to an author page, plus published/updated dates, with author and datePublished/dateModified in BlogPosting schema.

findings.title: Four duplicate-topic page pairs
findings.description: on-page-optimization-service (1,100w) vs -services (2,336w); which-on-page-element-carries (1,572w) vs -elements-carry (1,117w); /digital-marketing-freelancer-in-hyderabad (1,918w service) vs /post/ same slug (2,471w); digital-marketing-freelancers-in-india vs hire-digital-marketing-freelancer-in-india.
findings.recommendation: 301 the weaker into the stronger, but confirm with GSC impressions first.

findings.title: Five thin commercial pages
findings.description: /freelance-web-designers-in-bangalore 405 words, /social-media-marketing-for-doctors 689, /seo-service-for-dentists 814, /ppc-services 876, /best-digital-marketer-in-india 885 - against 2,234 for the page that ranks.
findings.recommendation: Expand toward the depth of /seo-freelancer-in-bangalore, prioritising /ppc-services.

findings.title: Unsourced quantified claims
findings.description: 'ROI on SEO alone can be 5-10x within 12 months'; '340% higher citation rate in AI' attributed to unpublished in-house research; '40-60% lower cost than a full-service agency'.
findings.recommendation: Publish the research, cite a third party, or soften to a defensible range.

findings.title: /seo-service-for-dentists has no H1
findings.description: Only page of 85 missing an H1. Also has no schema and 814 words.
findings.recommendation: Add an H1 matching the page's target term.

findings.title: 121 of 974 images lack alt text
findings.description: /ppc-services 9 of 10 missing; /outsource-digital-marketing-services 10 of 12; /best-digital-marketer-in-india 24 of 44; /freelance-social-media-marketing 14 of 35.
findings.recommendation: Accessibility obligation first. Start with the two near-empty pages.

findings.title: 25 meta descriptions exceed 160 characters
findings.description: Homepage is 247 characters, so roughly a third never displays. Hyderabad 243, Chennai 241. Separately, 7 descriptions are under 70 characters.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to 150-160 characters, homepage first.

findings.title: 36 of 85 titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Longest 82 characters. Truncation costs click-through, not ranking.
findings.recommendation: Batch-fix when editing pages for other reasons.

findings.title: 8 commercial pages have zero structured data
findings.description: Verified with a JSON-LD parser walking nested and array-form @type: /digital-marketing-freelancer-in-chennai (1,984w), -hyderabad (1,918w), /real-estate-seo-services (1,588w), /outsource-digital-marketing-services (1,275w), /seo-services-for-doctors (1,224w), /best-digital-marketer-in-india (885w), /seo-service-for-dentists (814w), /social-media-marketing-for-doctors (689w). Zero JSON-LD blocks, no microdata.
findings.recommendation: Clone the /seo-freelancer-in-bangalore @graph, changing areaServed, name, description and service type per page. Template already proven on this domain.

findings.title: ProfessionalService on 3 of 85 pages, FAQPage on 1
findings.description: Structured data is complete wherever Wix automates it and absent wherever it needed manual work.
findings.recommendation: Add Service entities to /ppc-services and /freelance-web-designers-in-bangalore (breadcrumbs only), and extend FAQPage to pages that already have visible FAQ blocks.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt exists (200) - ahead of most sites
Wix Site MCP endpoint at /_api/mcp lets agents query live content
All AI crawlers permitted under User-agent: * Allow: /
Strong entity signals: 7 sameAs on the Person including two .edu.in author pages and a featured.com profile

findings.title: llms.txt links only the homepage
findings.description: Wix-auto-generated. Lists one URL; none of the 17 service pages or 68 articles. Roughly 80% is boilerplate Wix MCP documentation.
findings.recommendation: Author a real llms.txt listing money pages and best articles with one-line descriptions. Single file, highest-leverage GEO action available.

findings.title: No author attribution or dates - binding citability constraint
findings.description: Assistants preferentially cite attributed, dated content. 68 undated anonymous articles are structurally disadvantaged in AI answers regardless of quality.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Content 2.2 - serves both categories.

findings.title: robots.txt disallows the path llms.txt advertises
findings.description: Disallow: /_api/* covers the /_api/mcp endpoint that llms.txt promotes. Agents calling directly are unaffected, but the two files disagree.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the two.

findings.title: AI crawler policy is implicit
findings.description: No GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot or Google-Extended directives. Access is allowed by default rather than by decision.
findings.recommendation: Declare it explicitly - also a client talking point for a business selling AI visibility.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Every sampled asset under 7 KB
Automatic resize and AVIF/WebP negotiation via Wix CDN
33 of 36 homepage images correctly lazy-loaded
Alt text quality is descriptive and not stuffed where present

findings.title: 35 of 36 images have no width/height attributes
findings.description: Browser cannot reserve layout space, so content reflows as images load. Classic CLS cause, applies site-wide.
findings.recommendation: Risk factor, not a measured failure. Check the GSC Core Web Vitals report before rebuilding anything.

findings.title: Above-fold logo is lazy-loaded
findings.description: First image in the DOM carries loading=lazy, deferring its request until layout and potentially delaying LCP.
findings.recommendation: Set loading=eager on the logo and any hero image.

findings.title: Business email is a gmail.com address
findings.description: eeatminds.in@gmail.com is published in the schema. Clutch, GoodFirms and other high-authority directories require a domain-matched email to verify a listing.
findings.recommendation: Move to shreyas@eeatminds.in, then update schema, contact page and footer. Gates the entire Foundation link campaign already staged in ../backlinks/.

findings.title: Opening hours declared 00:00-23:59 seven days
findings.description: Renders as 'Open 24 hours', not credible for a solo practitioner and inconsistent with how the business operates.
findings.recommendation: Declare genuine working hours.

findings.title: Google Business Profile not assessed
findings.description: Requires the GBP API or DataForSEO Maps; neither configured. Claim status, reviews, photos, categories and map-pack rank all unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Audit separately - ../backlinks/02-tracker.csv already calls GBP the highest-leverage local asset.
